safeCollecting.metadataDescription: Keep your NFTs in a vault that never connects, use 6529 from a hot wallet, and let consolidation, delegations and airdrops work for you. Set up your wallets step by step.
safeCollecting.title: Safe Collecting
safeCollecting.lead: Keep your NFTs in a vault that never connects to anything, and use 6529 from a hot wallet. Your TDH, delegations, airdrops and subscriptions keep working for you, as if every wallet were one.
safeCollecting.leadNoSubscriptions: Keep your NFTs in a vault that never connects to anything, and use 6529 from a hot wallet. Your TDH, delegations and airdrops keep working for you, as if every wallet were one.
safeCollecting.trust: Built on NFTDelegation, an open-source contract. Nothing on this page can move your NFTs.
safeCollecting.figure.label: Your vault, transaction wallet, social wallet and an old wallet work together as one collector
safeCollecting.roles.title: Your wallets, each with one job
safeCollecting.roles.description: This is the Three Address Protocol (TAP): the simplest way to never have your best NFTs phished. 6529 is built around it.
safeCollecting.roles.vault.name: Vault
safeCollecting.roles.vault.kind: A SAFE or a hardware wallet
safeCollecting.roles.vault.connects: Nothing, ever. Not even 6529. You only move NFTs in and out.
safeCollecting.roles.vault.on6529: Counts toward everything. Signs once, to appoint a manager.
safeCollecting.roles.transaction.name: Transaction wallet
safeCollecting.roles.transaction.holds: NFTs you are buying, selling or trading
safeCollecting.roles.transaction.on6529: Your vault's manager: it signs the vault's paperwork, so the vault never has to.
safeCollecting.roles.social.name: Social wallet
safeCollecting.roles.social.holds: No NFTs, just a little ETH
safeCollecting.roles.social.on6529: Signs in, votes, posts and pays for subscriptions.
safeCollecting.roles.social.on6529NoSubs: Signs in, votes, posts and mints.
safeCollecting.roles.old.name: Old wallet
safeCollecting.roles.old.on6529: Stays combined, so its TDH keeps counting.
safeCollecting.benefits.title: What it does for you
safeCollecting.benefits.description: One setup, and the whole system keeps working in the background.
safeCollecting.benefits.cold.title: Your NFTs stay cold
safeCollecting.benefits.cold.body: Nothing you do on 6529 needs your vault to connect. A phishing link can only reach a wallet that holds nothing.
safeCollecting.benefits.one.title: Everything counts as one
safeCollecting.benefits.one.body: TDH, full sets, boosts, levels and leaderboards add up across your wallets.
safeCollecting.benefits.hot.title: A hot wallet you can lose
safeCollecting.benefits.hot.body: Sign in, vote, post and mint from a wallet that holds nothing. If it is ever compromised, cut it loose from your other wallets.
safeCollecting.benefits.mint.title: Mint with your vault's eligibility
safeCollecting.benefits.mint.body: A delegation lets your social wallet use what your vault holds for allowlists and claims, without the vault connecting.
safeCollecting.benefits.airdrops.title: Airdrops land in your vault
safeCollecting.benefits.airdrops.body: Airdrops and subscription cards go straight to your vault.
safeCollecting.benefits.airdrops.bodyNoS: Airdrops go straight to your vault.
safeCollecting.benefits.profile.title: One profile, any wallet
safeCollecting.benefits.profile.body: Every combined wallet signs in as the same profile, so your vault never has to.

safeCollecting.setup.title: Set it up
safeCollecting.setup.description: Pick the path that fits you. Every step links to the tool that does it.
safeCollecting.setup.freshIntro: The recommended setup. Three wallets is enough to start.
safeCollecting.setup.existingIntro: Keep the wallets you have and move toward the recommended setup at your own pace.
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.wallets.title: Create three wallets
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.wallets.body: A vault (ideally a SAFE with hardware-wallet signers), a transaction wallet on a hardware wallet, and a social wallet in any wallet app.
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.manager.title: From your vault, sign once
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.manager.body: Give your vault an ENS name, and appoint your transaction wallet as its Delegation Manager for Any Collection. That is your vault's last transaction: from then on, its manager signs for it.
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.combine.title: Combine your wallets
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.combine.body: Run the guided setup with all three wallets. Your transaction wallet signs your vault's links as its manager, and the other wallets sign their own.
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.mint.title: Let your social wallet mint for your vault
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.mint.body: Acting as your vault's manager, your transaction wallet delegates minting to your social wallet. Allowlist spots that come from your vault can then be minted without it.
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.airdrops.body: Without a delegation, airdrops go to the wallet with the most TDH, usually your vault. If your vault delegates All to another wallet, add an Airdrops delegation back to the vault.
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.lock.title: Lock your vault
safeCollecting.setup.fresh.lock.body: Once your setup is settled, your vault can refuse new consolidation links. Nobody can then join it, not even with a stolen manager key. It has to unlock before you add a wallet later.
safeCollecting.setup.existing.combine.bo: Up to four, including burned or exposed old addresses whose TDH you want to keep. Old wallets just stay combined; you stop using them.
safeCollecting.setup.existing.vault.titl: Move your best NFTs to a vault
safeCollecting.setup.existing.vault.body: A wallet that never connects to anything. If your old vault's address is public, start a new one and keep the old one combined for its history.
safeCollecting.setup.existing.manager.ti: Appoint a manager for your vault
safeCollecting.setup.existing.manager.bo: Your vault signs once to make your transaction wallet its Delegation Manager. After that it never needs to connect here again.
safeCollecting.setup.existing.review.tit: Review who can act for your wallets
safeCollecting.setup.existing.review.bod: Check each wallet's managers, minting and airdrop delegations, and revoke anything you no longer use.

safeCollecting.caution.title: Worth knowing
safeCollecting.caution.manager: A manager cannot move your NFTs, but it can register anything in your vault’s name: combine it with another wallet, redirect minting and airdrops, appoint other managers. Make it a hardware wallet. An expiry date does not limit a manager; only revoking does, and revoking it does not undo what it registered.
safeCollecting.caution.expiry: An expiry date is only respected by apps that check it. The record itself stays until it is revoked.
safeCollecting.caution.keys: Every combined wallet can sign in as your profile. Only combine wallets you control, and revoke a lost or hacked wallet from your other wallets straight away.
